scope: Complete original noninterpolated PCM16 stereo kernel 0x402C18: random signed accumulator contents, raw samples, fractional forward/reverse/zero steps, all batch lengths 1..65, volumes 0..32, all 256 pan positions, nine master gains. Output bytes, final position and prefetched last sample match. Native transactional prefetch/capacity rejection and zero-count guard. Excludes loop traversal, PCM8 sources and interpolation.
